This department is a new interdisciplinary unit that was established in 2024 through collaborative efforts of faculty across its four areas: American Studies; Asian and Asian American Studies; Native American and Indigenous Studies; and Women’s, Gender, and Sexuality Studies, which includes a focus on Feminist Disability Studies. This position is the second among five additional lines planned for the Department. The next Department Head will provide strategic leadership to guide the development and implementation of a shared and coherent academic program. The department is dedicated to public engagement and interdisciplinary research, and we therefore solicit applications from academic leaders who possess wide-ranging administrative skills, expertise in team building, experience advancing collaborative research, and directing academic innovation. Demonstrated experience with supporting engaged scholarship and/or community partnerships. Demonstrated commitment to advancing diversity via research, teaching, scholarship, or in other ways.
